operating_thesis: Sequence useful refusals into a public operator ritual: name the dangerous sentence, teach the rejection rule, invite a bounded red-team, expose what changed, and end with a decision rather than a vanity recap.

slots.hook: The most dangerous sentence in an AI-generated launch plan is usually the smoothest one.
slots.creative_move: Open on the false inevitability of a polished pipeline claim, then reveal the four-line rejection test as a saveable operator tool.
slots.cta: Apply the four-line test to one current draft.
slots.intended_learning: Does a concrete rejection ritual earn qualified saves and replies from GTM operators?
slots.decision_rule: Continue only when replies identify a real claim or release gap; treat likes without operator detail as weak evidence.
slots.failure_recovery: If the opening is read as generic AI-safety commentary, replace the abstraction with the exact rejected sentence; do not intensify the market claim.

slots.hook: We built an AI GTM workflow and found that the most useful demo starts with a brief the system should refuse.
slots.creative_move: Show the approved fact, desired outcome and rejected sentence side by side; ask peers for the missing evidence class, not endorsement.
slots.cta: Name only the missing evidence class or decision owner.
slots.intended_learning: Can the community produce sharper falsifiers without sharing private campaign data?
slots.decision_rule: Promote a response into the next artifact only after a named editor verifies that it changes the evidence model.
slots.failure_recovery: If disclosure or context is challenged, pin the affiliation and synthetic-brief boundary before answering anything else.

slots.hook: Don’t hire an AI GTM employee to make forty assets. Hire it to reject thirty-nine.
slots.creative_move: Slides 1–3 reverse the volume promise; slides 4–5 label the seductive pipeline sentence; slide 6 shows the one source-bound card; slides 7–8 hand the operator a four-line rejection interview.
slots.cta: Run the four-line interview on one current draft before opening the evidence pack.
slots.intended_learning: Does the visualized decision boundary improve completion of the four-line audit?
slots.decision_rule: Retain the document format only if qualified users can restate all four fields without the caption.
slots.failure_recovery: If the document looks like compliance wallpaper, cut every frame that does not change the release decision.

slots.hook: The sentence your GTM agent should refuse
slots.creative_move: Deliver the audit only to explicit requesters and make the first action an inspection of their draft, not a product tour.
slots.cta: Run the audit on one draft before opening the evidence pack.
slots.intended_learning: Do explicit requesters use the worksheet to identify an actionable claim gap?
slots.decision_rule: No follow-up sequence unless the recipient asks to inspect a named boundary.
slots.failure_recovery: Suppress immediately on missing consent, ambiguous request state or unresolved identity mapping.

slots.hook: This week we deleted the sentence that made the launch sound successful.
slots.creative_move: Show the rejected outcome claim, the unchanged approved fact and the one evidence object still missing; treat deletion as the useful product behavior.
slots.cta: Which sentence would your release owner delete first?
slots.intended_learning: Does transparent subtraction create more qualified discussion than polished feature narration?
slots.decision_rule: Continue the receipt series only when each edition exposes a materially different decision failure.
slots.failure_recovery: If the receipt becomes self-congratulatory, remove the product name and test whether the lesson still stands alone.

slots.hook: Three ways our rejection rule could be wrong—and the evidence that would prove it.
slots.creative_move: Synthesize only permissioned response patterns, publish disconfirming cases first and separate an unresolved exception from a product defect.
slots.cta: Add a falsifier, not a testimonial.
slots.intended_learning: Can the campaign attract informed disagreement that improves the decision contract?
slots.decision_rule: Escalate a falsifier into product work only when it is reproducible on the frozen brief.
slots.failure_recovery: If no valid counterexample exists, publish the absence as missing evidence rather than manufacturing consensus.

slots.hook: The campaign verdict is allowed to be: stop.
slots.creative_move: Close with observed inputs, unresolved questions and an explicit stop/repair/continue recommendation; exclude reach or conversion claims that were not actually observed.
slots.cta: Reuse the decision format, not our conclusion.
slots.intended_learning: Can an evidence-first close make stopping or repairing feel like progress rather than failed content?
slots.decision_rule: A named human chooses stop, repair or continue; the scheduler cannot mutate strategy from engagement counts.
slots.failure_recovery: When observations are incomplete, choose stop-for-evidence and preserve the missing fields as null.

opponent_stress_tests.Hootsuite: Preserve cross-channel governance while making each scheduled object a distinct creative decision rather than a duplicated post variant.
opponent_stress_tests.Sprout Social: Turn social listening into a bounded hypothesis queue without allowing sentiment or engagement correlation to mutate strategy automatically.
opponent_stress_tests.Buffer: Keep the calendar legible and fast for a small team while retaining evidence, approval and recovery fields that lightweight scheduling often omits.
opponent_stress_tests.Later: Coordinate visual sequencing and preview logic without allowing aesthetic grid coherence to override the campaign learning sequence.
opponent_stress_tests.Metricool: Attach analytics to predeclared decisions and null outcomes rather than retrofitting a success story to dashboard counts.
opponent_stress_tests.Planable: Make review comments content-bound and preserve the exact approved artifact hash through approval and manual release.
opponent_stress_tests.Loomly: Generate creative prompts from the campaign spine without collapsing seven jobs into generic inspiration templates.
opponent_stress_tests.Publer: Retain operational speed, recycling and fallback behavior while preventing silent reposting after a claim or consent state changes.
opponent_stress_tests.SocialBee: Segment format and audience purpose without fragmenting the organizing idea or duplicating the same copy across categories.
opponent_stress_tests.Postiz: Use the open scheduler as a replaceable execution adapter while Temporal owns durable state and OpenLineage owns evidence bindings.

open_source_modifications.use: Replaceable scheduling adapter; no credential or publication authority in the candidate.
Durable slot, review, expiry and failure-recovery state machine with idempotent retries.
Bind every slot to the exact source asset, approval receipt and later observation without claiming causality.

truth_boundary: This is a source-bound draft calendar. No post was published, no schedule was activated, no platform signal was observed and no product comparison was completed.
